identity_prompt: An original pastel peach-pink friendly young cartoon bunny for ages four to six; simple clean vector-like outlines, dark brown eyes, cream heart-shaped chest patch, consistent front-view proportions, minimal soft shading. An internal KidsStudio character design, not an imitation of existing media.

parts.instruction: torso and pelvis only, with a complete uninterrupted shoulder/neck silhouette under the head and limbs
viewer-left leg and foot, joint-safe upper section concealed under body
viewer-right leg and foot, joint-safe upper section concealed under body
viewer-left arm and paw, with shoulder overlap hidden beneath head/torso
viewer-right arm and paw, with shoulder overlap hidden beneath head/torso
head and cheeks with complete hidden neck connection, WITHOUT attached ears, eyes or mouth
viewer-left separate long bunny ear and full hidden root
viewer-right separate long bunny ear and full hidden root
pair of identical dark-brown eyes, isolated facial-feature layer aligned to face
small neutral smile as isolated mouth layer, no other features
